instruction: VLC keeps playing videos in a continuous loop. I want to disable the automatic repeat feature so that when a video finishes, it stops instead of replaying from the beginning. Can you turn off the loop mode?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC does not have an automatic loop/repeat feature enabled by default when opening with no media loaded. The loop buttons exist in the interface but are not a persistent setting that can be pre-configured before loading media. Without a video file loaded in the config, there is no repeat behavior to disable.
